name: 14424 · Canandaigua, NY
findings: ZIP 14424 (Canandaigua) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14424 (Canandaigua) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14424 (Canandaigua) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
